narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video serves as an educational and promotional piece for a dermatology clinic. The speaker, a professional doctor, explains the technical advantages of using Sculptra (童顏針) for larger facial areas compared to hyaluronic acid. By detailing the biological mechanisms (collagen and elastin stimulation) and comparing the natural results, the video aims to build trust and encourage viewers to seek consultation at the mentioned clinic.
